title: Code and data for "Ergodicity Breaking of Active Inference in Carbon Trading before Tipping"
description: Python code and simulated data that reproduce every figure, table and quoted number of the Letter Ergodicity Breaking of Active Inference in Carbon Trading before Tipping (M. Ji and H. Xing, intended for Physical Review Letters) and its Supplemental Material. The code implements the active-inference buyer, the epistemic loop gain and the universal multiplicative map at a confounding contract, the ergodic epistemic value, the Bayes-optimal benchmark, and the calibration with emissions, mitigation pathways and carbon budgets. reproduce_all.sh regenerates all data and figures; paper_numbers.py prints the main quoted values; check/theory_checks.py tests the theorems numerically.
